title: Reject fluent-but-empty evaluator evidence
hypothesis: Validate will reject reports whose evidence is only aesthetic prose, including strings longer than 24 characters with no path, metric, or named artifact.
falsification_condition: A fixture whose evidence is fluent aesthetic text with no path or metric still returns Advance=true.
source_finding: Vacuous PASS still advances when evidence is fluent aesthetic prose

title: Bind evalgate to the research-loop done transition
hypothesis: A task cannot become status=done without a valid advancing evalgate Decision.
falsification_condition: tasks.json can still be set to done with no report or with composite_verdict=REJECT.
source_finding: Done-status path is not bound to evalgate

title: Compare evalgate to a non-handicapped schema-only checker
hypothesis: A required-field schema checker matches evalgate on valid_pass/valid_reject shape and accepts rubber_stamp.json.
falsification_condition: The schema-only checker rejects testdata/rubber_stamp.json or fails to accept testdata/valid_pass.json.
source_finding: Schema-only checker ties on field presence; ChecklistOnlyAccepts is handicapped

title: Bound LoadReport memory before decoding evalgate JSON
hypothesis: A file larger than MaxReportBytes fails via LoadReport without reading more than MaxReportBytes+1 bytes.
falsification_condition: LoadReport on a >MaxReportBytes tempfile succeeds or reads the whole file first.
source_finding: LoadReport/CLI size bound is post-hoc, not a memory fence

title: Give evalgate CLI a real caller or delete it
hypothesis: check-tasks will be the CLI's non-test caller; otherwise cmd/evalgate should be deleted.
falsification_condition: After the next round the CLI still has no non-test caller and is still in tree.
source_finding: Unused CLI and looser unused schema duplicate the Go gate
